# Renacity design reference

The user supplied [RealPacket/Renacity](https://codeberg.org/RealPacket/Renacity)
as the reference for a Neutron × Tenacity interface, retaining Neutron's Liquid
Glass effects. The inspected revision is
`27aa19974522528503f0736ca1c5aa43f51d6a88` (2026-11-02 inspection).

The reference informs compact category columns, centered menu composition,
search and side-panel navigation, and shared glyph atlases. Neutron's existing
configuration, theme, module and shader systems remain authoritative.

No LICENSE or COPYING file was found in the inspected tree. The repository's
README describing it as open source is not treated as a reuse license. The
Neutron font-atlas implementation is original code using the project's existing
font assets; no Renacity source or font files are included. Locally downloaded
reference excerpts remain under ignored `target/renacity-reference` only.

This document records design inspiration, not completion of every requested
screen or render module. The atlas checkpoint is documented in
[FONT-ATLAS.md](../FONT-ATLAS.md); menu and side-panel work is separate.
